scope: Durable authority-owned job lifecycle, global parser/write slot, D1/D2 job API and async/sync SDK; internal W1/W2 typed lifecycle only
implemented: Same authority SQLite database persists kind/stage/state, account+namespace+key request digest, effective configuration, original user principal, attempt/owner/fence/lease, checkpoint and info
Atomic authority commands claim/recover/renew jobs, reject late-owner heartbeat/checkpoint/parse writes and enforce stage progression
One database parser/write slot serializes all accounts, namespaces and backend jobs; confirmed written/aborted callbacks release it
Expired ordinary worker leases become resumable backoff; parser worker loss or cancellation quarantines the slot as write_recovery_required across authority restart
Known queued/ordinary-stage cancellation is durable; parser cancellation invalidates owner and retains unknown-write protection
Ready always requires a complete authority-verified publication gate; existing vector receipts and caller-supplied all_gates cannot produce ready
Internal Wiki draft_ready requires wiki_draft profile, wiki_validate stage, candidate checkpoint and diagnostic_published=false; job reads remain original-user and current-ACL restricted

POST /api/v1/kb/ingestion-jobs submits supported D1/D2 only with 202; GET /api/v1/kb/jobs/{job_id} and POST /api/v1/kb/jobs/{job_id}/cancel use current account/original user/current namespace and source ACL
Mixed upload/URI/build inputs, invalid to+parent combinations, D2 target overrides and unsupported D2 PDF/Office binary indexing are rejected before job persistence
Async/sync SDK create/get/cancel match current real job endpoints; collection migration inspection and expected-binding-digest CAS migration SDK parity added for KB-022
authority_integration_owner: registry_authority agent incorporated DurableJobsMixin/init_jobs and the 12 fixed job command proxies into PublicationStore and authority
runtime_integration_owner: root agent owns DocumentJobRuntime and real resource/reindex handlers plus app lifecycle registration; this report does not replace its integration evidence

verification.command: .venv/bin/python -m py_compile openviking/indexing/jobs.py openviking/service/kb_job_executor.py openviking/service/kb_job_service.py openviking/server/routers/kb_jobs.py sdk/python/openviking_sdk/kb.py

process_evidence.description: Two independent spawned worker processes and a separately spawned authority serialize three differently scoped D1/D2/W1 jobs; real monotonic start/end events prove no overlap; persisted checkpoints survive handoff. Workers use timed parser callbacks, not real PDF/Office/model inference.
process_evidence.description2: An independently spawned worker is terminated before/after acquiring parser slot; authority process is restarted; ordinary stage retries with higher attempt/fence, unknown parser retains its slot and rejects both late owner and another parser.

current_boundary.D1_D2: Durable document submission/API lifecycle and registered worker callbacks implemented; parent integrates current resource/reindex services
current_boundary.W1_W2: Core lifecycle records support these kinds, but generic document API rejects them; current Wiki prepare remains HTTP 200 prepared; no unfinished execution endpoint is exposed
current_boundary.ready: Fail closed without a complete authority commit receipt; no queue-done or old vector-publication ready shortcut
current_boundary.draft_ready: Internal original-user private status only; real candidate body ACL/materialization/complete schema validation remains unverified
current_boundary.unknown_write: Slot protection persists; no TTL/operator self-report releases unknown writes

remaining_conditions: Trusted real backend terminal/fencing proof and atomic recovery of a quarantined parse slot are not implemented; unknown writes can block all parsers until that recovery exists
Authority fence rejects lifecycle state mutations, but real AGFS/model/backend delayed writes still need enforced writer fencing and fault-injection validation
Actual parser outputs, Office-to-PDF flow, full three-model quality, original upload-byte digest pinning and long-job parser costs are not proven by timed worker callback tests
Index dispatch crash window and full generation publication/ACL intersection receipt protocol remain to be closed; real ready remains unavailable
Persisted principal is refreshed by parent runtime's identity service; complete permission revocation throughout actual parser/index backend calls is not proven here
Wiki execution/extraction/identity merge/schema coverage and physical private candidate validation remain unimplemented or unverified
Worker attempt retention/operational metrics, job list UI, quotas, durable audit history, physical deletion and GC remain follow-up work
No complete Feature or D1/D2/W1/W2 FLOW acceptance is claimed
workspace_handling: No commits/resets; preserved existing changes; did not directly edit publication.py/registry_authority.py/shared spec; coordinated authority inheritance with its owner and runtime integration with root.
